name: Homelab MCP Server
description: Enables Claude to monitor and manage homelab infrastructure including Docker containers, OPNsense firewall, and TrueNAS storage with configurable capability levels from read-only monitoring to full management control.

rawRecord.description: Enables Claude to monitor and manage homelab infrastructure including Docker containers, OPNsense firewall, and TrueNAS storage with configurable capability levels from read-only monitoring to full management control.

PORT.description: The port the server will listen on

API_KEY.description: Your API key for authentication (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32)

TRUENAS_HOST.description: The hostname or IP address of your TrueNAS server (optional)

OPNSENSE_HOST.description: The hostname or IP address of your OPNsense firewall (optional)

CAPABILITY_LEVEL.description: The capability level for the server (1-4). Level 1: Monitor (read-only), Level 2: Operate (start/stop), Level 3: Configure (read configs), Level 4: Manage (full control)
